user.title: Connect to Columbia Gas of Ohio
user.description: Enter the username and password you use to log in at myaccount.columbiagasohio.com.

reauth_confirm.title: [%key:common::config_flow::title::reauth%]
reauth_confirm.description: The Columbia Gas portal rejected the stored password for {username}. Enter the current password to reconnect.

init.title: Columbia Gas of Ohio options
init.description: Changing this reloads the integration and applies immediately.

data.expose_account_details: Show service address and account holder on the bill sensor

data_description.update_interval_hours: How often to sync with the portal. The portal's usage/billing history only advances once a month, so shorter intervals just re-request the same numbers.
data_description.expose_account_details: Off by default. Sensor attributes are saved in Home Assistant's history database and can be read by dashboards, voice assistants and other integrations, so the address and name stay out of them unless you turn this on.
